# Cully v0.31.1

Fixes an empty Claude status bar left behind by older Cully installs.

- **The problem.** Releases before 0.27 wrote `cully _internal statusline` into Claude's `settings.json`. That command was removed in 0.27 and nothing cleaned the entry up, so plain `claude` showed an empty bar, and `cully run claude` forwarded every refresh to the dead command and printed `unknown internal action "statusline"` to the terminal.
- **The fix.** `cully setup` and `cully uninstall claude` now remove only that exact entry, and `cully run claude` stops forwarding to it. A status line you wrote yourself is never touched, and a launch still never edits your saved settings.

The Cully panel inside `cully run claude` was not affected: it keeps showing model, context, tokens and limits from its own feed.

Update with `cully update`, then run `cully setup` with your original options once to clear the old entry. Until you do, `cully run claude` already ignores it.
